memo.regime_insight: The system works best when it concentrates risk on VIRTUAL LONG signals during early distribution regimes, where intermediary buying pressure (IPS) and whale net flows can still drive sharp upside, and when the BIAS filter actively blocks the underperforming SHORT and AERO traps. High volatility and bearish funding on other tokens are a headwind; the edge is narrow and token-specific.
memo.signal_trust: - **v2_TCI_roll3_LONG_T24 on VIRTUAL**: 1/1 with +31.28% TP hit, the only signal with a clean, high-conviction win in the recent sample. The T24 horizon gives it time to ride the order-book imbalance noted in the regime card. - **composite_LONG_T6 on AERO/MORPHO**: Two recent TP hits (+8.41%, +7.73%) despite historically poor token performance. The composite aggregation appears to filter noise better than individual rules; these deserve a cautious allocation when they fire with BIAS=NEUTRAL or L
memo.blind_spots: We are not dynamically sizing based on token-specific edge. The fixed $100 notional per trade ignores that VIRTUAL’s win rate and payoff are demonstrably superior, and that diversification across dead tokens is a drag. A simple Kelly-inspired allocation that overweights VIRTUAL and zeros out AERO/VVV/MORPHO would likely improve risk-adjusted returns. Also, our TP/SL levels are static; the recent 3h SL hits suggest the -4.2% to -8.7% stops may be too tight for the current volatility on some token

If composite_LONG_T6 fires on AERO or MORPHO with confidence ≥65, take a **half-size $50 position** with a trailing take-profit at +6% (to avoid the +8–10% TP hit turning into a reversal).
